name: Luma Dream Machine
desc: Free text-to-video model that hit 1M users in days
desc_zh: 免费开放的文生视频模型，上线四天用户破百万
solves: You want to try text-to-video but aren't sure what it produces, and you don't want to pay first. Here you can generate a few free seconds and look.
solves_zh: 想试文生视频但不确定效果，也不想先付费。这里可以先免费生成几秒片段看看。
best_for: When a concept test beats a production render — you need a look, not a film.
best_for_zh: 当你要的是先看一眼概念效果，而不是成片交付时。
notes: 首页地址已不再是 Dream Machine 独立页：现落地在 Luma 更大范围的创意 Agent 站（标题「Creative agents for creative professionals」），Dream Machine（Ray3）作为其中的视频模型存在。域名未失效，未改 homepage 字段。

revisions.from: You want a low-cost look at what text-to-video can actually produce.
revisions.to: When a concept test beats a production render — you need a look, not a film.
revisions.why: 原文只是把 solves 换了个说法；改成真正的使用场景判断
